_doc: THE FOUR OVERWORLD LANDSCAPE CAMERAS, written down at last.
docs/qa/ow-land was measured on four viewpoints that were never recorded anywhere, so
the landing lane could not reproduce them and had to re-derive its own baseline. These
are the re-derived four, pinned to ROAD STATIONS of tools/valley_map.py's ValleyField so
they survive a map edit: station 12 is the Emberbrook gate portal, 126 the gorge shelf,
168 the Dellhollow approach. yaw is the road tangent (the same formula valley_export.py
uses for the spawn), pitch 0.61 is the shipped follow camera.
Expand with tools/ow_probe/land_spec.py; capture with tools/ow_probe/ow_multi.mjs.
